lines.text: Saul keeps two thousand men at Michmash while Jonathan leads a thousand and attacks the Philistine outpost at Gibeon.
The people are summoned to Saul at Gilgal, and the Philistines camp at Michmash while Israel's men hide in caves.
Raiders leave the Philistine camp in three divisions, and only Saul and Jonathan have swords or spears among Saul's troops.
